summary: The exact-head Runner failure receipt is recovered. Compatible native tooling is required before validation can resume; no new supported nonduplicate finding or approval is proposed.

blockers.detail: The recovered exact-head Runner build exited 1 in logging's pinned fmt headers with C2653/C2061 errors for stdext::checked_array_iterator. Themes completed, but Runner did not produce an executable. The audited host has VS2026/MSVC14.51/v145 and no compatible v143 compiler. No new passing build is claimed.
blockers.remediation: Install or use Visual Studio 2022 Desktop development with C++ and a compatible v143 compiler/STL. Explicitly enter its x64 developer environment and verify the actual compiler selection. Restore the unchanged pinned head and submodules, including spdlog 616866fcf40340ea25a8f218369bad810ef58e72. Restore PowerToys.slnx with /t:restore /p:RestorePackagesConfig=true, then run tools\build\build.ps1 -Platform x64 -Configuration Debug -Path src\common\Themes and -Path src\runner. Retain selected compiler, commands, exit statuses and outputs. After successful exact-head Runner validation, reassess existing upstream review 4897872260 rather than automatically approving or repeating already-posted requests.

upstream_head.scope: Recovered exact-head Themes/Runner native build; Themes completed and Runner failed in pinned logging headers.
